title: Which Game Has Won the Most GOTY Awards? The Most-Awarded Games Explained
description: Which games have won the most Game of the Year awards? Neural Critic breaks down the modern GOTY record, why award totals vary by tracker, and the games that dominate the all-time conversation.
body: There is no single official worldwide Game of the Year count. For this ranking, Neural Critic uses Meta Awards' current documented totals, which count both media-outlet GOTY picks and readers' choice awards. The database can change as historical records are added or reclassified, so these figures should be read as a tracker snapshot rather than one universal official total.
author: Rouane Mounssif
tags: The Last of Us Part II
imageAlt: The Game Awards logo displayed over the event’s stylized orange winged trophy artwork.

contentBlocks.text: Meta Awards currently records 544 Game of the Year wins for Clair Obscur: Expedition 33, putting it at the top of the tracker’s all-time table. That total includes 390 media-outlet picks and 154 readers’ choice awards. The figure is a tracker snapshot rather than an official industry-wide count, and it can change as the database adds or reclassifies historical records.
contentBlocks.caption: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 became the current leader in Meta Awards’ all-time GOTY tracker after a dominant 2025 awards season.
contentBlocks.heading: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33
contentBlocks.imageAlt: Members of Expedition 33 face a surreal landscape of floating ruins and monumental structures in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33.
contentBlocks.subtitle: The current leader in Meta Awards’ all-time tracker

contentBlocks.text: Meta Awards currently records 438 GOTY wins for Elden Ring. Its 2022 awards season reset the modern ceiling at the time and remains one of the strongest consensus runs in the tracker’s history.
contentBlocks.caption: Elden Ring combined enormous critical acclaim with a dominant awards run following its 2022 release.
contentBlocks.heading: Elden Ring
contentBlocks.imageAlt: A Tarnished kneels beneath a glowing Elden Ring symbol in key art for Elden Ring.
contentBlocks.subtitle: The 2022 benchmark that still sits second all time
contentBlocks.platforms: PC, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S

contentBlocks.text: Meta Awards currently records 325 GOTY wins for The Last of Us Part II. It was the modern tracker leader before Elden Ring overtook it and remains one of the most decorated releases in the database.
contentBlocks.caption: The Last of Us Part II became one of the most decorated games of its generation during the 2020 awards season.
contentBlocks.heading: The Last of Us Part II
contentBlocks.imageAlt: Ellie stands against the flooded ruins of Seattle in key art for The Last of Us Part II.
contentBlocks.subtitle: The previous modern record holder before Elden Ring

contentBlocks.text: Meta Awards currently records 292 GOTY wins for Baldur's Gate 3. Its 2023 run paired hundreds of publication and reader picks with victories across the highest-profile industry ceremonies, making it one of the broadest consensus seasons of the modern era.
contentBlocks.caption: Baldur’s Gate 3 turned its extraordinary critical reception into one of the strongest Game of the Year awards runs of the modern era.
contentBlocks.heading: Baldur's Gate 3
contentBlocks.imageAlt: The main cast of Baldur’s Gate 3 gathers beneath a stormy sky as dragons and other creatures emerge around them.
contentBlocks.subtitle: A 2023 sweep across outlets, readers and major ceremonies

contentBlocks.text: Meta Awards currently records 281 GOTY wins for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt. That total keeps CD Projekt Red’s 2015 RPG firmly inside the tracker’s all-time top five.
contentBlocks.caption: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt became one of the most celebrated RPGs of its generation, collecting major Game of the Year recognition throughout the 2015 awards season.
contentBlocks.heading: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
contentBlocks.imageAlt: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt logo in white and red against a dark background.
contentBlocks.subtitle: A 2015 awards sweep that still holds a top-five place
contentBlocks.platforms: PC, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch

contentBlocks.text: Meta Awards currently records 267 GOTY wins for God of War, placing the 2018 release just ahead of Breath of the Wild on the tracker’s all-time table. Its season was especially notable because it shared the year with Red Dead Redemption 2, another major critical favorite.
contentBlocks.caption: God of War emerged from a fiercely competitive 2018 field as one of the year’s most celebrated releases.
contentBlocks.heading: God of War
contentBlocks.imageAlt: Kratos and Atreus confront a massive troll during combat in God of War.
contentBlocks.subtitle: The 2018 winner that currently holds sixth place

contentBlocks.text: Meta Awards currently records 265 GOTY wins for The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild, two fewer than God of War in the tracker’s present all-time table. Its 2017 awards run remains one of Nintendo’s strongest modern consensus seasons.
contentBlocks.caption: Breath of the Wild transformed Nintendo’s open-world design and became one of 2017’s defining award winners.
contentBlocks.heading: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
contentBlocks.imageAlt: Link overlooks the vast landscape of Hyrule from a grassy cliff in The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild.
contentBlocks.subtitle: Nintendo’s 2017 landmark currently sits seventh

contentBlocks.text: Meta Awards currently records 257 GOTY wins for The Last of Us. Together with its sequel’s 325 wins, that helps make The Last of Us one of the strongest franchises in the tracker’s aggregate awards history.
contentBlocks.caption: Naughty Dog’s The Last of Us dominated year-end recognition in 2013 and became one of the defining games of its era.
contentBlocks.heading: The Last of Us
contentBlocks.imageAlt: Ellie and Joel stand together during a scene from The Last of Us.
contentBlocks.subtitle: A 2013 landmark with 257 tracked GOTY wins

contentBlocks.text: Meta Awards currently records 230 GOTY wins for The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim. Because the awards ecosystem was smaller in 2011 than it is today, its raw total also reflects a very different media landscape from more recent record-setters.
contentBlocks.caption: Skyrim became a landmark open-world RPG and one of the most acclaimed releases of 2011.
contentBlocks.heading: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim
contentBlocks.imageAlt: The Dragonborn walks through the Nordic village of Riverwood in The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim.
contentBlocks.subtitle: A 2011 giant from an era with fewer tracked awards
contentBlocks.platforms: PC, PlayStation 3, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox 360, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch

contentBlocks.text: Meta Awards currently records 191 GOTY wins for Uncharted 4: A Thief's End, making Naughty Dog’s 2016 release the tenth game on the tracker’s current all-time leaderboard. Astro Bot sits just outside that top ten with 185 tracked wins in the same database.
contentBlocks.heading: Uncharted 4: A Thief's End
contentBlocks.subtitle: The current cutoff for Meta Awards’ all-time top ten

quickRead: Meta Awards currently lists Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 first with 544 tracked GOTY wins
Elden Ring remains second with 438 tracked GOTY wins
The Last of Us Part II sits third with 325 tracked GOTY wins
conclusion: The safest way to read GOTY records is not as one immutable number but as a measure of awards-season reach. Different trackers will disagree at the margins, yet the historical picture is remarkably consistent: a small group of games — led in the modern era by Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 and Elden Ring — collected an extraordinary share of year-end recognition. Neural Critic will keep this page updated as tracking databases revise historical totals and future awards seasons produce new challengers.
